about: F4: RI = log2(n/p) - h(s/p), binary64-log2. Fixed oracle constants; halfphase is exactly one bit below inphase. No objective for near-phase is specified.

Under the handed integer domain: p=1 has only s=0; even p>=2 minimizes at p/2; odd p>=3 minimizes at (p-1)/2 and (p+1)/2. Maximum is at s=0. The formula can be negative when n=p; no physical worst-case interpretation is supplied.

On nonzero integer shifts 1<=s<p, p=1 has an empty domain, p=2 has the sole shift 1, and p>=3 has both maximizing shifts 1 and p-1. Calling the expression phase defect is a definition of signed arithmetic, not proof that it measures common-part entropy or physical phase information.

coverage.why: finite arithmetic checks; not a general proof
